# VieSchool Fast Track

> Free Vietnam airport fast-track and immigration guides for international travelers at fasttrack.vieschool.com. Covers real immigration queue times at SGN, HAN and DAD, when meet-and-greet fast-track service is worth paying for, and how Vietnam e-Visa and airport arrival actually work.

## Guides

- [Is Vietnam airport fast track worth it?](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-airport-fast-track-worth-it.html): Honest verdict by airport - queue lengths, prices, who should skip it
- [Vietnam e-Visa and fast track guide](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-evisa-fast-track-guide.html): e-Visa vs visa on arrival, entry steps, where fast track fits
- [Vietnam immigration wait times](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-immigration-wait-times.html): Real queue ranges at SGN, HAN, DAD by time of day

- [Vietnam e-Visa processing time](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-evisa-processing-time.html): Official 3 days vs real 3-10 - why applications stall and what to do
- [Visa on arrival vs e-visa](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-visa-on-arrival-vs-evisa.html): Fees, paperwork and the extra airport queue - which route is faster for you
- [Fast track cost](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-airport-fast-track-cost.html): Per-person price ranges by tier and what moves the price
- [Meet and greet service](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-airport-meet-and-greet.html): Where the agent meets you and what arrival/departure/transit packages include
- [Departure fast track](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-airport-departure-fast-track.html): Check-in, security and exit-immigration queues - when the departure service pays off
- [SIM card at Vietnam airports](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-airport-sim-card.html): eSIM vs pickup vs counters - prices and carrier coverage

- [Hanoi airport immigration time](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/hanoi-airport-immigration-time.html): Noi Bai's two daily queue banks - 20 or 75 minutes depending on arrival window
- [Ho Chi Minh airport immigration time](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/ho-chi-minh-airport-immigration-time.html): SGN's 60-100 minute evening peak and the quiet windows
- [Vietnam e-visa for Indians](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-evisa-for-indians.html): US$25/$50 fees, steps, real 3-10 day processing
- [Vietnam arrival card](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/vietnam-arrival-card.html): What travelers actually fill out - the paper card is mostly dead

## Airport guides

- [Noi Bai airport fast track (HAN)](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/noi-bai-airport-fast-track.html): Queue banks at Terminal 2, meet & greet flow, when to book
- [Tan Son Nhat airport fast track (SGN)](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/tan-son-nhat-airport-fast-track.html): Vietnam's longest immigration queues - when fast track earns its money
- [Da Nang airport fast track (DAD)](https://fasttrack.vieschool.com/da-nang-airport-fast-track.html): Usually the fastest airport - when it still pays off and when to skip
